featured_reviews.name: Harmonics In Action
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am posting this review after 1 year of usage. and this is being posted using hotspot from mobile. The DNA internet service is horrible, customer support is a nightmare. It is good till it lasts, once you get an issue with internet, you are doomed. You will try to reachout to customer support, they will not pick the call, if they do, there will be a huge queue build up, and if by any miracle, you get to speak to one, the will simply say, we have logged complain, it will be resolved in 7 days. 7 day? really? is that a turn around time?

And trust me you, they do take that much time. Once they had to change the fiber optic as they say, they cut the internet on Friday afternoon, and said its weekend for us, will work only on Monday. Two days they didn't care about it. Had they not cut the internet, it would have worked fine till they change it on Monday. but NOOOOO.

The only way they are surviving is that they are the up against Tikona. The day another player comes in, they are doomed.

featured_reviews.name: Nupur Swetambari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Titan Eyeplus, Chandivali, Near Mamaji’s medical Store.
Here are some great reasons not to visit this store ever.

Usually for eye related issues I used to go to Hiranandani Titan Eyeplus. When I saw one of the showrooms of Titan Eyeplus in my area Chandivali then went to it to change my spec's lenses.

Sakina and Arshad were there. I would recommend everyone please if you want to save your time and free from drama and tantrums then never visit this showroom ever. The lady Sakina is full of lies.

Here is the list of lies which she felt so proud of while saying it after giving my order on the date 19th Feb, 2022. She called me on 22nd Feb 2022 for submission of my spectacles as lenses have arrived.

1. Ma'am you would get your spectacles tomorrow at 7 p.m. Date-19th Feb 2022.

2. On 20th Feb, 2022 I was not able to go to the Titan Eyeplus, Chandivali because of some issues.

3. On the 21st I arrived at Titan Eye Plus, Chandivali to get my spectacles exactly at 5 pm. She (Sakina) said that the delivery boy is coming by bus. He would reach within 5 mins so you need to wait Ma’am. I said I could not wait. I need to pick my nephew from daycare. She took my address for home delivery.

4. After reaching home I gave her a call after an hour. She said the delivery boy is old so he is taking 1 hour to reach my location. Additionally, he had to do one more delivery in my building too. According to Google Maps, to reach my home by vehicle takes 6 mins, and by walking it takes 19 mins to cover the distance of 1.3 to 1.4 km.
5. I called after an hour. Now Arshad said, Ma'am I would be leaving now and would reach within 10 mins. Now this delivery boy had converted into a young boy from an old man.

6. I called again to shout and asked to tell the truth, and I would definitely write a feedback regarding this.

7. Sakina called to apologies

and she came with some new excuse that the old delivery had left now someone else would come to deliver my order. I told her directly why you were giving me stories, and this call from Sakina was basically to not to give her negative feedback when I had sent this message to Arshad last time.

8. Story continued like this and every time I called the only message I had received was that it would get delivered within 10 minutes, and finally I got my order at 9 pm. I waited from 5 pm to 9pm just to get my own spectacles. This order I was supposed to get one day before at 7 pm.

The packaging was poor too because they thought I was already going to give negative feedback so how does it matter if it would give this customer poor packaging service.

Below are some pictures attached of their poor packaging services along with the history of 6 outgoing calls to the store and 1 incoming call from the store from Sakina.

I have never expected such poor service from Titan as i am a or should i say i was long term regular customer of Titan Eyeplus Hiranandani.

The question still remains the same.

Is this COVID -19 had forced Titan to hire such low quality and not trustworthy staff?

Or is it Quality vs. Quantity?
